detector._note: Keypoints 23-11-13 / 24-12-14 (hip-shoulder-elbow), 3D world angle. Rest is 10-20 (TOP at <=20), the top of the raise is 90 or more (BOTTOM at >=90); wrist only feeds the straight-elbow alignment score.

stage._note: Measured with pose_landmarker_full over the reference clip, 6 Sep 2026: WRIST_HEIGHT reaches -0.025 to +0.004 m at the top of a textbook raise and -0.42 to -0.46 m at the bottom. The old pair sat at 0 and 0 — adjacent, with no hysteresis, and demanding the wrist go ABOVE the shoulder when a lateral raise ends level with it. -0.08 counts a raise to shoulder height with 5 cm of margin; -0.25 rests well before the arms hang fully.

tempo._note: measured window: topExit crossing -> bottomEnter crossing, not the full descent

cues.enter: Face the camera, arms hanging at your sides (10–20°).
cues.tooHigh: Raise the arms out to the sides to shoulder height — 90° at the shoulder.
cues.framing: I can't see your hips — step back.
